trap.label: want/need to
trap.wrong: I need that you help me.
trap.right: I need you to help me.
trap.why: Em português usamos 'preciso que você me ajude'; em inglês, need + pessoa + to.

mcq.q: Because/so: It's late, ___ I go home.

fix.wrong: I'm late, because of I woke up late.
fix.right: I'm late because I woke up late.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para negativa: “I want to go.”
Una com so: “It's cold. I wear a coat.”
rewrite.answer: It's cold so I wear a coat.
